final: WITH large AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds AS bpm FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804), per AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM large GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(n) AS avg_tracks_per_media_type FROM per
